title: The isolation contract: each dimension holds as stated, and each probe can see it fail
note: Assurance I (D-2026-176). Four mutations remove a mechanism the executor relies on (namespaces, a clean environment, the CPU and address-space rlimits); five make a probe pass what it did not observe; one makes the contract claim a syscall filter. tests/test_isolation_contract.py holds each, on a host with unprivileged namespaces.

mutations.name: IS1_namespaces_are_never_entered
mutations.rationale: I: no user, pid or net namespace; high_assurance must then refuse every tool

mutations.name: IS2_the_environment_is_inherited
mutations.rationale: I: a tool inherits the caller's credentials and tokens

mutations.name: IS3_no_cpu_limit
mutations.rationale: I: a CPU-bound tool runs to the wall bound

mutations.name: IS4_no_address_space_limit
mutations.rationale: I: a tool allocates past its address-space bound

mutations.name: IS5_the_network_probe_passes_anything
mutations.rationale: I: the probe reports a network boundary it did not observe

mutations.name: IS6_the_namespace_probe_passes_anything
mutations.rationale: I: the probe reports namespaces it did not observe

mutations.name: IS7_the_tree_probe_ignores_the_grandchild
mutations.find:
"holds": r.outcome is Outcome.TIMED_OUT and first is not None
            and after == first}
mutations.replace: "holds": r.outcome is Outcome.TIMED_OUT and first is not None}
mutations.rationale: I: a grandchild that outlives the tool goes unnoticed

mutations.name: IS8_the_quota_probe_ignores_the_cpu_run
mutations.find:
holds = (cpu.outcome is Outcome.FAILED and cpu_ended_after < 10.0
             and mem.get
mutations.rationale: I: a CPU bound that never fired is reported as holding

mutations.name: IS9_the_credential_probe_ignores_the_file
mutations.rationale: I: a credential file the tool could read is not reported

mutations.name: IS10_the_contract_claims_a_syscall_filter
mutations.rationale: I: the contract says the kernel filters system calls; nothing does
